SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Why aren't you saying anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Don't tell me you plan on staying silent...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Am I someone whose existence is trivial to you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I just don't know how to phrase it. It's not that you aren't important or anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: So that's what my existence is to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Someone about whom you can't find an answer. That's about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...N-Nothing of that sort.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: If so, why can't you come up with an answer?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: T-That's...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: How could you be trivial to me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Hmph. Whatever you say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Forget it, even if you're just saying it to humor me... I'm a bit happy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Is that so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...However, if that's the case, why are you remaining silent?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's because I don't know how to say it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Oh really. So you've stumbled onto this situation when you're unable to give an answer.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You truly are a helpless nice guy...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Never thinking about yourself, always jumping into action... That's why you always barge in without first considering what others might think or what

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: kind of situation they are in.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You even try to meddle with things that are beyond your ability.
...True, I haven't considered it before... I'm just thinking that being hardworking will certainly bring us somewhere...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Kuh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ......Heh. Seems like I've hit the bulls-eye.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's not over yet, is it? There must still be something we could do?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Isn't it still too early to be giving up? Why can you say that so easily?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...It is as you say. As long as we don't give up, there must be a way. People often say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Though that's the babbling of an ignorant person who doesn't understand anything about the situation...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That is... Certainly, I'm not as knowledgeable as you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: However, for that reason let me say this. As long as we don't lose hope, we'll manage somehow!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Good grief... I really need to learn a little from your unyielding motivation.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Even so, a schedule like this is impossible from the start.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It was very strict from the start, yet a novice like you wants to join in...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It seems to be that way. Whichever wicked gods there be, they are all calling me to give up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...It's not impossible. There's still something we can do, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: What else can we do? Try saying it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: L-Like I said, I'll pay for--

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...And I'm telling you that's a nuisance.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's a dead end. We don't have any solution. We're like rats driven into a corner.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: There's a saying that goes 'A cornered rat will bite the cat'. Even if it's us...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: We're different from a rat... It is useless to struggle any further.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-How could you put it that way...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Because that's the truth? There's no other solution...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I'm sure deep down in your heart you have already given up, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...That's not how I feel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Right. I was certain you would say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: However, I don't need that. I don't care if your meddling is out of good will or kindness, I don't need any of that.
...Damn. Isn't there something I could do?
......No good. I can't think of anything I could do...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Damn it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That's right. Even we can't rise from the verge of death anymore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's a pity... A Bad End.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Sometimes, peoples' good will can backfire. That's exactly what happened here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...What did I do to make it backfire...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I told you, didn't I? This is my creation, if I'm not happy with it, there's no meaning in doing it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I don't want to continue if I must receive other people's charity.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Charity...? I didn't mean something like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But in the end it became that way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-You're wrong.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It doesn't matter what your intentions were, the situation is as such. I'm not able to do anything and you want to solve that, obviously.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But, my pride won't allow something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I'm really grateful for your help. However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: This game of make-believe is hereby over.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...What's with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Don't ask for returns if we are to maintain good relations. What's the difference between this and a child's game of make-believe?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why are you being so masochistic?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...The one unable to answer was you, wasn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That's why, the thing that binds us is no more.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmph... To be more specific, isn't this the same as acting as siblings?
This girl... is she still worrying about that?
No, that's not right... She is just giving herself up to despair...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...It's just a little further until we're done, right? Think about it again...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's not what you're thinking for real too, right? It seems like you're just hurting yourself...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Acting...? What's with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But isn't that the case?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It isn't! I told you it's not that way. You can't let this incident make you lose sight of yourself!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Let's just end this already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: End it... end what?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ............Everything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: All the manuscript work we were doing up until now, and also this fake-drama...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's with that!? Was that the extent of your passion?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Was this something so cheap to let it slide using the word 'drama'?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: And yet you call it fake!? Was everything you were doing up until now all fake!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's something yours, and yours alone, right? You called it your own work, right!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Isn't this one of those production hardships you had to go through!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Do I seem hurt? I'm just merely stating a fact.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: If we're not acting like siblings, then I guess we're imitating friendship? It sounds like a childish youth TV drama...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...No... It's not that, you know? You need to calm down a little. Stop joking about this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Hehe. That's right... Indeed, it was just nonsense just now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...However, this trouble is all reality.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...But if you don't give up, you can still manage somehow, isn't that right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...That's right. That's my desire... But there are situations that you just can't do anything about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Urgh, enough! When someone is trying to say something constructive, you shut it down immediately!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You're just my kouhai, so don't get cocky. Just be quiet and accept your senpai's good-will.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Heh... Now you can't even form decent words, what is it now? You're getting angry at me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's true those words are ones which describes our relationship... But, you won't say that you got involved with me because of those kind of words?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: My only kouhai is you alone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You're too noisy! Wake up and listen to me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: No. It's all pointless to continue any further.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You're my important kouhai!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Heh. Senpai and kouhai? Aren't I just one of the many kouhai that you have?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's not true! You're my only kouhai!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: This has got nothing to do with other people! I'm really worried about you, troubled over your problems, meddling with your issues, all just to see

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: you smile!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That's right, at most, the tablet broke. But it is a problem which I as a high-school student can't solve.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I don't have the money, it's absurd to borrow from other people.... It's fatal. I can't do anything at all. It's checkmate.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Fatal, you say....

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: There's no way around it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What are you talking about as if you know everything? Hear what your senpai has to say to you sometimes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmph... You can't even say decent things now, so you're appealing from that position?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's true that those words are the ones which describes our relationship... But, you won't say that you got involved with me because of those kind of

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: words?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: My only kouhai is you alone!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Wha... Y-You have a lot of other kouhai, don't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, that's right. But the only important kouhai for me is you alone.
